text:
Jia: Quick follow-up on RFC-241 (modular paydown). Thinking we should pick 3 debt cohorts to move in the next quarter. Proposed criteria: customer impact, cross-service coupling, and extract safety. Thoughts?

Mike: +1 on cohorts. can we lock on the adapter surface first? low blast radius, high reuse.

Anil: agree with adapter surface. also we must land an observability contract before extraction — otherwise cutovers become a mountain to debug.

Tara: when you say 'lock' do you mean owner, timeline, and a rollback plan? need clarity on operational acceptance.

Jia: yes. owner = team that will do final testing + rollout. timeline = 6 weeks per cohort (2-sprint runway + 2-sprint cutover + buffer). rollback = canary lanes + explicit fallthrough policy.

Mike: propose a lightweight "debt-ledger" pattern: tag JIRA issues with DEBT-COHORT, add migration checklist columns, and a single spreadsheet that mirrors the ledger for exec visibility. I'll create the sheet.

Jia: sketch of the safety lifeboat policy (draft):
```
- rollout path: canary 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%
- gating: 99p latency, p95 latency delta, error-rate, token-cost delta
- fallback: immediate failover to previous model/service variant if any gate trips
- observability: tracing + token-level accounting on the canary lane
```

Anil: add a requirement for trace-context propagation + per-request token cost tags. without that we can't correlate regressions to the rollout.

ops-bot: Infra notice: cluster maintenance window Mon 09:00–11:00. avoid schema or node pool changes then :warning:

Tara: noted. I'll avoid scheduling cutovers during the window. I'll also document owner/timeline/rollback in the RFC thread and set up a 30m sync for Thursday.

Jia: action items to move forward:
- Mike: create debt-ledger + spreadsheet (share link) by EOD
- Tara: schedule sync + update RFC with owner/timeline/rollback
- Anil: draft observability contract (trace, token accounting, dashboards)
- Everyone: add 1 high-impact, low-risk candidate to the ledger by EOD

Mike: ack :thumbsup:

Tara: ack :calendar:

Anil: infra side has no blockers for the cadence.

Jia: if no objections we'll adopt a 6-week cohort cadence starting Sep 6. speak up now or bring it to the sync.

Mike: fine by me.

Tara: fine. i'll push the calendar invite.

Jia: closing this thread for now — thanks all. ping me in-thread if you want to propose a different candidate or timeline.
